notes.title: New in Version 2.0.0
notes.content:
▼[b]What's New in Version 2.0.0:[/b]

[list]
[*] Customize your farm however you like!
[*] Plant, harvest, and sell your crops!

[/list]

[list]

[*] Korean
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7
notes.content:
▼[b]Important Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Kapperor's voiceover to enhance immersion during shop interactions.
[*] Resolved a bug that prevented players from exiting Kapperor's store.
[*] Fixed an issue where the fishing rod did not appear when needed for fishing.
[*] Eliminated a critical error that reset player saves at certain points in the game.
[*] Applied minor fixes aimed at improving stability and gameplay.
[/list]

▼[b]Feedback Channel:[/b]

We continue to value your feedback! Share your thoughts and suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/yHxk5M5gkf]Discord[/url]. Your voice shapes the future of V-Monsters!

===

▼[b]Message from Red Studios:[/b]

Red Studios would like to express immense gratitude to everyone who purchased V-Monsters at launch. Your support has been crucial to the game's success. Don't forget to add V-Monsters to your Steam wishlist and help us grow! Thank you for being a part of our journey!

notes.title: Updated! Play V-Monsters Digital Farm now!!
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

===

▼Major Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a persistent dialog box bug at the farm that prevented accessing the monster interaction menu.
[*] Resolved the issue with a giant egg appearing when purchasing a new egg at Kapperor's shop.
[*] Adjusted the game clock that was hidden behind the coin panel.
[*] Implemented corrections in the Portuguese localization of the Guaxinito minigame, fixing previously incorrect words.
[*] Fixed a bug causing Festival of Light event dialogues to incorrectly appear at the farm.
[/list]

▼What's New:

[list]
[*] Added an exit button in the settings menu for easier game closure.
[*] UI elements have been resized for PC players, enhancing the experience for those playing on a computer (originally ported from a mobile game).
[/list]

▼Feedback Channel:

Please share your feedback and suggestions on our Discord channel #vmonsters-steam. Your input is invaluable to us!

▼Message from Red Studios:

We at Red Studios are immensely thankful for everyone's support. Remember, adding our game to your Steam wishlist greatly supports us! Thank you for everything.

notes.title: Christmas and New Year with a Special Event!
notes.content:
Hello, players!

As the year draws to a close, we want to take this moment to extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you. It's been an incredible year filled with adventures and fun, all thanks to your ongoing support and passion for our game.

[h3]🌟 Special End-of-Year Event - Now Available on Mobile! 🌟[/h3]

We are thrilled to announce that our end-of-year event is now available on the mobile version of the game! This event is our way of celebrating with you, bringing joy and festivity.

[h3]✨ Event Highlights:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Festive Christmas Skins:[/b] Dress your characters in exclusive themed skins and get into the holiday spirit!

[*] [b]Fully Voiced Story Event:[/b] Dive into a special Christmas adventure with an engaging, fully voiced storyline.
[/list]

[h3]📱 Available for Free on Android[/h3]
For those who haven't yet tried, our game is available for free download on Android. Join the fun and participate in this wonderful end-of-year event!

[h3]💻 Coming Soon to PC - Early Access on Steam[/h3]
And there's more! Early next year, our game will be available in Early Access for PC, exclusively on Steam. Get ready to elevate your gaming experience!

[h3]🌟 A New Year Full of New Adventures![/h3]
As we bid farewell to 2023 and welcome 2024, we look forward to sharing even more exciting moments and amazing news with all of you.

🎄 Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year from Red Studios! 🎉
